q1.text:
Settled in this pass — and what is still yours

1 · The scan now happens IN the Workspace: a band under the Original header reports it, and the Scan screen is only options and detail. Nobody has to leave the workspace to be protected.

2 · Entity ≠ Vault. An entity is an identity — CLIENT #17. The values under it (company name, contact, IBAN, e-mail, customer number), each with its own aliases and policy, are what the vault keeps encrypted. The vault list shows identities; the entity card shows the values inside one.

3 · The top-bar control is now «Privacy Pack · German (DE)», not «Language», and its screen says in the first line that it does not change the interface language.

4 · Review shows all three states in one list — auto protected, suggested, manual — each with its own badge, mark and reason. The stepper walks only the suggested ones.

5 · The answer has two fixed buttons, Restored View and AI View, 44 px, always in the same place.

6 · Three behaviour boards spell out every button's states, including what is Disabled and why. Read those before the programmer starts.

Still yours to rule: desktop only, or a phone shape too? · one Privacy Pack for the whole app, or one per profile? · may «Send anyway» ever be switched on at all?
